offers_products.reason: Sells food, beverages and arcade games at its venues as a major part of revenue, alongside bowling.

offers_services.reason: Main offering is entertainment experiences: bowling lanes, leagues, party hosting, waterparks and attractions.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Families, birthday parties, league bowlers and casual guests visit its bowling centers, waterparks and family entertainment parks.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Corporate and holiday events are booked by companies; PBA media and sponsorship deals involve organizations, though this is a smaller part.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from per-visit spending on games, food and parties; leagues and regulars exist but most is transactional.

cyclical_demand.reason: Bowling outings, parties, dining and waterpark visits are discretionary entertainment that households can easily cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sale is a bowling game, meal, drinks or party ticket: small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for venues, lanes, attractions, food and drink; the facilities drive the value, not staff expertise.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households, families and groups, plus some small corporate events; not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and operates hundreds of bowling centers, waterparks and family entertainment parks requiring heavy property investment.
